text:
emily-support: Customer reports repeated 5xx + timeouts from hosted inference since ~10:15 UTC. They see a bunch of connection resets and streaming hangs. Repro steps below, they've been looping SDK retries and hitting billing counts.

emily-support: customer id=acme-corp, sample request id: req_2026_1741112247. Timestamped errors attached. They said it started after a deploy ~10:05.

emily-support: repro steps they shared:
```
# python sdk pseudocode
resp = client.generate(prompt, stream=True)
# client sits waiting, then gets a socket reset or 503
```

sre-oncall: looking. Can you paste the raw error payload or first 5 error lines from the client? Also which region/edge they hit?

emily-support: pasted from customer: 
```
ERROR: Stream closed unexpectedly, errno=104
HTTP/2 stream error: RST_STREAM
status: 503, body: {"error":"gateway_error","id":"req_2026_1741112247"}
```

opsbot: [alert] edge-eu-west1 spike: 503 rate increased to 4.2% at 10:14 UTC (baseline 0.4%).

maya: I pulled gateway logs for req_2026_1741112247 — upstream returned ECONNRESET from backend pool node gpu-12. Stack shows TLS conn reset during kvcache fetch.

raj: Noted. We had an auth-rotation job at 10:08 that briefly refreshed edge certs / tokens. Could be connection churn with long-lived http2 streams. Any multiplexing turned on for this customer?

emily-support: customer SDK defaults to multiplexing=true (they didn't change). They saw failure mostly on long streaming requests (>30s).

maya: hypothesis: token rotation + http2 stream reuse => backend resets + client retries trigger fanout and overload on a few backend nodes, causing a cascade 503. Quick verify: I found a metric jump for grpc/stream_reset on backend pool gpu-12 at 10:13.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan: deploy quick config to disable http2 multiplexing + force new connections for streaming routes for 10m for affected edge. Also add a small retry-jitter client recommendation. I'll push a hotfix route override.

deploy-bot: [deploy] route-config override to edge-eu-west1 applied by sre-oncall at 10:21 UTC (id cfg_1741112281).

sre-oncall: rolled override. Early telemetry shows 503% down to 0.6% for that edge and connection reset events declining.

emily-support: sent interim note to customer: "We've applied a temporary routing change to avoid reusing long-lived HTTP/2 streams; please try again and let us know if you still see resets. We'll follow up with root cause & permanent fix." They confirmed fewer errors after 10:24.

raj: follow-ups: 1) root cause RCA to confirm auth-rotation window handling and HTTP/2 connection draining logic, 2) consider a server-side drain that terminates streams gracefully on token rotation, 3) SDK guidance: recommend retry backoff and optionally disable multiplexing for long streams until fix.

maya: I'll collect logs and create postmortem ticket with timeline and patch suggestion (drain hook + token rotation grace).

emily-support: marking thread as customer-handoff complete for now. Will update ticket when RCA is done. :white_check_mark:
